concept.title: Where to find an English bookshop in Paris?
concept.shortdesc: If you're in Paris wondering where to find your next read, you're in the right place! Whether you're an anglophone tourist visiting Paris or a local willing to learn English, you'll find everything you need in this guide.

p.b: Here is an extensive list of Anglophone bookshops in Paris:

li.p: Smith and Son (main shop): 248, 250 Rue de Rivoli 75001
Shakespeare and Company: 37 Rue de la Bûcherie 75005
The Abbey Bookshop: 29 Rue de la Parcheminerie 75005
San Francisco Book Co: 17 Rue Monsieur le Prince 75006
The Red Wheelbarrow Bookstore: 9, 11 Rue de Médicis 75006
